Description: Machined bed support arms for the RatRig V-Core 4 and newer, by Mandala Rose Works. Machined from 6061 aluminum on Kelvin-style kinematics, replacing the printed bed arms. Works with the kit's RatRig wobblers or Mandala Mini Oldhams, and is IDEX/VAOC compatible. Single size/fitment; price $149.00 is the only variant.
Name: Bed Support Arms — V-Core 4
Verdict Label: Machined Kelvin-kinematics bed arms for the V-Core 4
Pros: Machined from 6061 aluminum (vs printed stock arms) for a rigid bed mount; based on Kelvin-style kinematics; works with the RatRig wobblers from the kit or Mandala's Mini Oldhams; IDEX/VAOC compatible (as of 12/13/2024) with updated printed parts on Printables; uses the nuts provided in the RatRig kit; 4 thru holes added 3/24/2025 to support either wobblers or oldhams
Available Sizes: One size — fits RatRig V-Core 4 / 4.1 (VC4 and higher)
Cons: Requires a modified wiper (two Printables options linked on the page); using both bed spacers loses 5 mm of Z and needs a config adjustment (or remove one spacer from the pin-mount arm); stock Oldhams cost Z height — Mini Oldhams recommended (extra purchase); V-Core 4/4.1 only — 3.0/3.1 arms are a separate listing
